# Pet trading-card maker

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/pet-card/

Turn a pet photo into a custom collectible-style card. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Add a pet’s name, a playful title and three custom stats to create a shareable card.

## Limits and checks

The words and stats are for entertainment and are entered by you; the tool does not infer temperament or health from a pet photo.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
